name: bounded-runtime-harness
description: Package governance contracts and a fail-closed bounded runtime harness for ChatGPT and Codex coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Turn governance policy into a fail-closed execution controller
interface.longDescription: Install this plugin to load the governance skill and the bounded-runtime-harness skill. Governance writes evaluation-first markdown contracts. The harness compiles those contracts into proposal envelopes, inference gates, runtime gates, transactional worktrees, byte-identity commits, and tests that forbidden actions cannot execute. Layer 0 decoder constraints are best-effort on ChatGPT UI and enforceable only on stacks that expose decoder controls.
defaultPrompt: Scaffold evaluation-first governance files for this repository, then install the bounded runtime harness against those contracts.
Compile existing .harness contracts into a fail-closed bounded runtime controller with forbidden-action tests.
Review this change against the review-repair invariants and refuse any repair that expands scope.
